lede: A new DeepSeek model was the one thing the machine-learning corners of the web agreed on today. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 reached the top of both Hacker News and Hugging Face at once, with the Hacker News thread flagging a score of 45 on Artificial Analysis. The rest of the day scattered: an undated photograph crossed Bluesky and Mastodon, and Grand Theft Auto drew a crowd across Steam and YouTube. Sixteen of the seventeen feeds reported in, with only Wikipedia leaving an empty column.
